_selection.criterion: Samples are selected for whether they EXERCISE the pipeline, not for family diversity. The previous corpus was chosen on family labels and produced zero cross-tool correlations on all 7 samples; the MOTIF corpus (n=29) likewise produced zero, with Volatility never triggering. See #426.
_selection.split: Split from the single curated manifest on 2026-08-31. A .NET cell and a native-PE cell are not the same measurement, so they are TWO experiments and are never pooled (#505). Splitting the manifest rather than relying on a convention is what makes pooling impossible: the provenance stamp records which corpus produced a scorecard and its hash changes when the manifest does (#486).
_selection.modality_note: Ghidra decompiles these. This is the corpus behind the #420 stage-2 result.

excluded_from_both.reason: raccoonstealer — Cape extracted no PE and the sample is not .NET, so neither analyser produced anything to read
icedid — same: 'no PE files found', not .NET routed

_selection.build: corpus_dir entries do not exist until built. Each requires a full pipeline run (detonation, Volatility, Ghidra) with the resulting report.json and persisted Ghidra project copied into corpus_dir. The interpret stage can be disabled for the build; the eval harness supplies its own.

roles.negative-control: expected to produce zero; retained deliberately
